### Important safety information

### Lingo

* * * *

The Lingo Glucose System is intended for users 18 years and older not on insulin. It is NOT intended
for diagnosis of diseases, including diabetes.

The Lingo program does not guarantee that everyone will achieve the same results as individual
responses may vary. Consult your healthcare professional before making changes to your diet or
exercise regime or if you have an eating disorder or a history of eating disorders.

The product images are representative only.

develop products from concept to launch, and navigate FDA and global approval pathways with
integrated CDMO services designed for speed and regulatory compliance.

value-added support services.

### Full Service

We support your lateral flow assay from concept to launch and beyond.

[Learn more][45]


### Contract LFT Development

We are experts in design for manufacture, reagent assessment & evaluation of materials for prototype
development for Proof of Concept & Optimisation of your device to Design Freeze.

[Learn more][46]

Transferring processes from bench to pilot / validation batches, in line with our QC methodology,
plus Supply Chain support & formal SOPs & BOMs ready for Final Output Review.

[Learn more][47]

Flexible solutions from tailored strip & card manufacturing – reagent prep, spraying, lamination –
to full kitting and assembly, foiling & QC processes to Final Batch Release.

[Learn more][48]

Dedicated in-house consultants supporting GAP analysis, technical file build, clinical trial design
& implementation, stability, analytical & transport studies, all the way to approval submissions.

[Learn more][49]

Supported by a highly experienced commercial team, benefit from strategic Go-To-Market support,
account management, retail & wholesale distribution network opportunities and post market
surveillance assistance.


### Packaging

Full support on design, sourcing, management of supply chain and packaging services.

[Learn more][50]

flow tests][52] across all industry sectors, including healthcare, animal health and plant health.

technical requirements of IVD and [companion diagnostic development][53].

We take projects from development through scale-up and into routine large-scale manufacturing. We
also offer flexible solutions such as card and strip manufacture, device assembly, product kitting,
regulatory support, and commercialisation.

We also supply lateral flow products globally to consumers, retail, wholesale and distributors
across multiple industries. See [our rapid test brands][54].

# Customized. Sensitive. Fast.

Your drug-discovery breakthrough depends on accurate biomarker testing results. At **Ampersand
Biosciences**, we’re committed to understanding your research goals as well as you do. It’s how we
deliver customized immunoassay kits and testing services that bring your science closer to market.

## Sample Testing

Have a Luminex or ELISA assay you would like us to test for purity, safety, potency, and yield?
We’ll test samples of mouse, rat, hamster, canine, and human biomarker samples using validated assay
and GLP protocols.

[Sample Testing Services][34]

## Assay Development

We offer Luminex Multiplex Assay Development and ELISA development for application-specific
solutions to fit your unique use cases.

[Assay Development Services][35]

## View All Services

[Services][36]

## Antibodies & Proteins

We package and sell both monoclonal and polyclonal antibodies that are validated with native samples
and undergo rigorous validation prior to release. We also have recombinant proteins available for
Western Blot and ELISA antibody assay testing.

[Antibody & Protein Products][37]

## Luminex Kits

Our Luminex Multiplex Cytokine Panels are available in a standard well plate or a 96 well plate. We
validate all kits for cross-reactivity, linearity, precision, and stability. New lots undergo
bridging studies to ensure excellent lot-to-lot reproducibility.

[Luminex xMap Products][38]

## View All Products

[Products][39]

## Why Choose Ampersand Biosciences?
* ### Experience.
  
  The Ampersand Biosciences team has decades of expertise in developing and validating Luminex-based
  and other multiplex assays, antibodies, and proteins.
* ### Independence.
  
  As a privately owned women business enterprise (WBE), we answer to ourselves—not a distant
  corporate headquarters. And because we’re independent, our costs are often lower than larger
  providers.
* ### One-of-a-kind.
  
  Our newly developed ferret cytokine panels—the first on the market—provide an important tool to
  evaluate the immune response to influenza as well as other respiratory diseases. We’re constantly
  evaluating ways to meet your pre-clinical research needs: Our hamster cytokine panels for
  evaluating COVID response are the only ones available.
* ### Speed.
  
  If you have limited experience performing multiplex immunoassays, turn to Ampersand Biosciences.
  We’ll execute your experiment in our secure facility located in a remote part of Northern New
  York, saving you time and money. We can complete most projects in 2–4 months.
* ### Quality.
  
  Your experiments depend on replicable, reliable data. (We know the frustration of encountering
  antibodies that don’t work—that’s one reason why we started producing some of the ones we rely on
  in-house.)

## Grants & Research Section

Our team has decades of combined experience and is a driving force in pharmaceutical research.
Ampersand Bio is a two time winner for the SBIR grant and has been published or cited in many
academic papers.

[More About Our Research][40]

Ampersand Biosciences was the recipient of the SBIR award in 2020, 2022, 2024 for immunologic
analysis of non-mammalian and underrepresented mammalian models with a focus on several infectious
diseases including influenza and SARS-Cov-2. Through these awarded grants, Ampersand Biosciences has
been able to develop reagents to better understand and describe immune response to infection and
support biomarker and countermeasure development through immunological research.

[Read more][41]

# Customized. Sensitive. Fast.

Your drug-discovery breakthrough depends on accurate biomarker testing results. At **Ampersand
Biosciences**, we’re committed to understanding your research goals as well as you do. It’s how we
deliver customized immunoassay kits and testing services that bring your science closer to market.

## Sample Testing

Have a Luminex or ELISA assay you would like us to test for purity, safety, potency, and yield?
We’ll test samples of mouse, rat, hamster, canine, and human biomarker samples using validated assay
and GLP protocols.

[Sample Testing Services][34]

## Assay Development

We offer Luminex Multiplex Assay Development and ELISA development for application-specific
solutions to fit your unique use cases.

[Assay Development Services][35]

## View All Services

[Services][36]

## Antibodies & Proteins

We package and sell both monoclonal and polyclonal antibodies that are validated with native samples
and undergo rigorous validation prior to release. We also have recombinant proteins available for
Western Blot and ELISA antibody assay testing.

[Antibody & Protein Products][37]

## Luminex Kits

Our Luminex Multiplex Cytokine Panels are available in a standard well plate or a 96 well plate. We
validate all kits for cross-reactivity, linearity, precision, and stability. New lots undergo
bridging studies to ensure excellent lot-to-lot reproducibility.

[Luminex xMap Products][38]

## View All Products

[Products][39]

## Why Choose Ampersand Biosciences?
* ### Experience.
  
  The Ampersand Biosciences team has decades of expertise in developing and validating Luminex-based
  and other multiplex assays, antibodies, and proteins.
* ### Independence.
  
  As a privately owned women business enterprise (WBE), we answer to ourselves—not a distant
  corporate headquarters. And because we’re independent, our costs are often lower than larger
  providers.
* ### One-of-a-kind.
  
  Our newly developed ferret cytokine panels—the first on the market—provide an important tool to
  evaluate the immune response to influenza as well as other respiratory diseases. We’re constantly
  evaluating ways to meet your pre-clinical research needs: Our hamster cytokine panels for
  evaluating COVID response are the only ones available.
* ### Speed.
  
  If you have limited experience performing multiplex immunoassays, turn to Ampersand Biosciences.
  We’ll execute your experiment in our secure facility located in a remote part of Northern New
  York, saving you time and money. We can complete most projects in 2–4 months.
* ### Quality.
  
  Your experiments depend on replicable, reliable data. (We know the frustration of encountering
  antibodies that don’t work—that’s one reason why we started producing some of the ones we rely on
  in-house.)

## Grants & Research Section

Our team has decades of combined experience and is a driving force in pharmaceutical research.
Ampersand Bio is a two time winner for the SBIR grant and has been published or cited in many
academic papers.

analysis of non-mammalian and underrepresented mammalian models with a focus on several infectious

been able to develop reagents to better understand and describe immune response to infection and
support biomarker and countermeasure development through immunological research.

  It is used for qualitative detection of IgA-class antibodies to Epstein-barr virus early antigen

  management of patients related to infection with Epstein-barr virus.
  [Read More][37]

  Hepatitis E virus IgM Test Cassette is used for qualitatively detection of Hepatitis E Virus IgM
  antibodies in human serum, plasma (EDTA, heparin, sodium citrate) or whole blood (EDTA, heparin,
  sodium citrate). The test is to be used as an aid in the diagnosis of viral hepatitis, which is
  caused by Hepatitis E Virus.

Nanoparticle innovation
ready for field use.

[Learn More][27]

## Draw on our deep expertise across industries.

Translate your project needs into precision-engineered diagnostic assays for diverse applications,
including medicine, veterinary care, food industry, pharmaceuticals, industrial monitoring,
environmental, and biodefense.
* [Woman with stethoscope treating patient]
* [Man with livestock holding tablet]
* [Woman in safety vest and construction helmet holding tablet]

## Capabilities

BioAssay Works has a a 20+ year proven track record of providing custom, turnkey lateral flow assay
solutions for leading-edge companies.
* ### Services
  
  We offer custom assay development, contract manufacturing, and custom gold conjugation services
  that align seamlessly with your vision and goals.
  
  [Learn More][28]
* ### Products
  
  Our products leverage core technologies to help our customers bring lab-based assay sensitivity to
  point-of-care, rapid assays.
  
  [Learn More][29]

## What our customers say

> Working with Bioassay Works (BAW) delivered us top notch efficiency, improved assay performance
> and reduced development cost. Undoubtedly, BAW was a stellar product development partner that
> brought special touch of quality, responsiveness and dedication to our project, which allowed us
> to rapidly advance our product to market.”
> 
> Manufacturer of novel diagnostic tests for unmet global health needs

## Articles
* [Antibody-Drug Conjugates (ADC) —a monoclonal antibody with a cytotoxic payload —moving towards a
  cancer cell target.]
  
  ## Two Molecules, One Test: What ADCs Demand from Identity Testing
  
  ADCs have changed the requirements for identity testing. Unlike conventional monoclonal
  antibodies, they require manufacturers to confirm two independently variable molecular components
  within a single therapeutic product while distinguishing that product from an increasingly complex
  portfolio of related molecules. [(more…)][33]
* ## Biotherapeutic Identity Testing: From Novel Concept to Mission-Critical Manufacturing
  ## Requirement
  
  As biologics portfolios expand, identity testing has shifted from a regulatory checkbox to a
  mission-critical manufacturing risk — and the tools to manage it have never been more capable.
  [(more…)][34]
* ## LFA vs ELISA: How to Choose the Right Diagnostic Method (Sensitivity, Speed & Use Case)
  
  Lateral flow assays (LFA) and enzyme-linked immunosorbent assays (ELISA) are widely used
  immunoassay techniques. Choosing the right method depends on application, sensitivity, and
  environment. Both methods have been around for over 50 years, and each has earned a well-deserved
  place in diagnostics. But they are not interchangeable — ELISA offers high sensitivity, while LFA
  provides rapid results. Understanding where each excels is critical to selecting the right tool
  for your application. [(more…)][35]

Nanoparticle innovation
ready for field use.

[Learn More][27]
[Close up of hand interacting with test]

## Draw on our deep expertise across industries.

Translate your project needs into precision-engineered diagnostic assays for diverse applications,
including medicine, veterinary care, food industry, pharmaceuticals, industrial monitoring,
environmental, and biodefense.
* [Woman with stethoscope treating patient]
* [Man with livestock holding tablet]
* [Woman in safety vest and construction helmet holding tablet]

## Capabilities

BioAssay Works has a a 20+ year proven track record of providing custom, turnkey lateral flow assay
solutions for leading-edge companies.
* ### Services
  
  We offer custom assay development, contract manufacturing, and custom gold conjugation services
  that align seamlessly with your vision and goals.
  
  [Learn More][28]
* ### Products
  
  Our products leverage core technologies to help our customers bring lab-based assay sensitivity to
  point-of-care, rapid assays.
  
  [Learn More][29]

## What our customers say

> Working with Bioassay Works (BAW) delivered us top notch efficiency, improved assay performance
> and reduced development cost. Undoubtedly, BAW was a stellar product development partner that
> brought special touch of quality, responsiveness and dedication to our project, which allowed us
> to rapidly advance our product to market.”
> 
> Manufacturer of novel diagnostic tests for unmet global health needs

  Ijamsville, MD
  
  BioAssay Works proudly marks its 20th anniversary of being at the forefront of reagent innovation
  and customized development and manufacturing services. [(more…)][32]

## Articles
* [Antibody-Drug Conjugates (ADC) —a monoclonal antibody with a cytotoxic payload —moving towards a
  cancer cell target.]
  
  ## Two Molecules, One Test: What ADCs Demand from Identity Testing
  
  ADCs have changed the requirements for identity testing. Unlike conventional monoclonal
  antibodies, they require manufacturers to confirm two independently variable molecular components
  within a single therapeutic product while distinguishing that product from an increasingly complex
  portfolio of related molecules. [(more…)][33]
* ## Biotherapeutic Identity Testing: From Novel Concept to Mission-Critical Manufacturing
  ## Requirement
  
  As biologics portfolios expand, identity testing has shifted from a regulatory checkbox to a
  mission-critical manufacturing risk — and the tools to manage it have never been more capable.
  [(more…)][34]
* ## LFA vs ELISA: How to Choose the Right Diagnostic Method (Sensitivity, Speed & Use Case)
  
  Lateral flow assays (LFA) and enzyme-linked immunosorbent assays (ELISA) are widely used
  immunoassay techniques. Choosing the right method depends on application, sensitivity, and
  environment. Both methods have been around for over 50 years, and each has earned a well-deserved
  place in diagnostics. But they are not interchangeable — ELISA offers high sensitivity, while LFA
  provides rapid results. Understanding where each excels is critical to selecting the right tool
  for your application. [(more…)][35]
